ops.text: (c) Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Licensor shall (i) at Licensee's request, provide transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Licensor's then-current rates; (ii) within 30 days after such expiration or termination, return to Licensee all Licensee data stored in or processed by the Licensed Technology ("Licensee Data") in a standard machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete Licensee Data from its systems and certify such deletion to Licensee in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article XXI obliges only us to hand materials back, so we have added a Licensor transition and data-return paragraph: up to six (6) months' assistance at Licensor's then-current rates, return of Licensee Data within 30 days after expiration or termination in a standard machine-readable format, and certified deletion thereafter. If six months is too long, we can discuss 90 days of assistance with the same 30-day export.
proposal.summary: Insert Article XXI(c) requiring Licensor transition assistance, 30-day return of Licensee Data in a standard machine-readable format, and certified deletion after return.
